title: Built a text-based AI story game where your choices actually stick and NPCs remember everything you say
author: unknown-alien-
selftext:
Made DreamVessel - a text-based choice game powered by AI where every decision you make has lasting consequences.

How it works:

You read a scenario, pick from multiple choices

AI generates what happens next based on your decision

NPCs remember your past actions (threaten someone in Episode 3, they refuse to help in Episode 7)

Stats track your progress (money, health, episode count)

What makes it different from other text games:

Every playthrough is unique (AI-generated, not pre-written)

Real consequences - bad choices can get you killed or broke

Different genres (crime, fantasy, sci-fi, survival)

Dynamic currency per story type (medieval stories use Gold, modern use Cash, cyberpunk use Credits)

Try it free (3 episodes, no signup needed): https://dreamvesselai.vercel.app

Built this solo over 3 months, just updated the UI to look more game-like. Zero users so far - looking for honest feedback.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body:
My experience with your site.
1)beyond the first page the images stopped loading. 2) I clicked the get started and it got to the first choice of each of the two presets and the game shows there is no more story and sends me back to the originals.
3. I chose the cyberpunk story to make my own and when it asked if I wanted to continue as a guest, it throws some kinda html error.
I stopped after that. If I'm being critical, what did you spend those months on? Your landing page feels very low effort, nothing exciting at all just some plain text in bubble wrap UI generated by an AI I assume, (the cyberpunk option is a picture of trees, so it's kinda clear you didn't even make it yourself) 
There are already a ton of these AI story makers and yours didn't even work. I think it's important to ask yourself if the thing you are making is actually any fun to play, because Imma gonna be real honest, a choose your own text adventure has to be one of the boringest things imaginable and even if you ran this, you would crater to usage costs as it's just another wrapper.

replies.author: unknown-alien-
replies.body:
Thanks for taking the time to try it and give honest feedback - this is exactly what I needed.
You're right, the bugs you hit are critical
Story Originals ending after first choice
Guest mode HTML error
Wrong images (cyberpunk showing trees)
I'm fixing those today. The app should work but clearly doesn't for the demo flow, which defeats the whole purpose.
On the "boring concept" point - fair criticism. Text-based games aren't for everyone. I built this because I personally wanted AI stories where choices actually stick (most AI story tools have goldfish memory), but I get that the market might not care.
Appreciate you being real instead of just scrolling past. Going to fix the bugs and decide if it's worth continuing or pivoting to something else.
